title: Answer: full-body illusions, dream reports, meditation surveys and neural correlates

statements.text: The theory is checked by experimentally controlled full-body illusions, by statistical re-evaluation of the thousands of dream reports already gathered, by sleep-lab studies of lucidity, by psychometric questionnaires on pure awareness in meditators, and by computational and neuroscientific study of minimal phenomenal experience.
